fusions.name: Palmed Edge
fusions.desc: Flicks a blade into the first enemy it meets, dealing 5 damage and making it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Cut the Tendon
fusions.desc: A slash behind the knee that deals 16 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. It uses up every other affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Unseen Pass
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds: enemies notice you 70% later and you move 25% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Within Reach
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next strike has 25% more critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds.
